notablePrerequisites: You control at least eleven lands.
description:
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating a Treasure token for each land you control, and returning it to your hand due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{U/R}{U/R}{R}.
Repeat.
